Lumia hero layout options

Low-fidelity structure explorations for the landing page hero in ClientApp.

A

Split pitch + workspace preview

Closest to the current direction: strong message stack on the left, product context on the right, proof anchored below the headline.

B

Centered statement + proof strip + demo below

More editorial and campaign-focused: the hero reads top-down, with social proof and the product preview spanning the full width underneath.

C

Asymmetric story rail

Most distinctive option: a slim narrative rail, a bold central headline block, and a supporting proof/actions column to create a stronger visual rhythm.

Compare the overall reading flow, CTA placement, and how much weight the product preview should carry in the first screen.
